Sample Person Six
Financial Analyst | FP&A, Forecasting and Financial Modeling | Helping consumer brands plan with confidence
Los Angeles, California

About
Financial analyst focused on FP&A, forecasting, and budgeting for consumer products companies. I build the models and the monthly reporting that leadership uses to decide where the next dollar goes.

In three years at Example Foods I have owned the operating expense forecast, rebuilt the monthly variance analysis, and supported two annual budget cycles from kickoff to board deck. My forecasts have landed within 2% of actuals for six straight quarters, and the close package I redesigned saves the team about ten hours every month.

I started in accounting, so I care about where the numbers come from as much as how they look on a slide. I am strongest in Excel and SQL and I am working toward the CFA Level I exam.

Always glad to compare notes on FP&A. Message me here or email sample.six@example.com.
